description: Use this when the person asks to change a Webba design already shown: its name, tagline, colour, graphic, lettering or name placement. Keeps everything they didn't mention. Ready made designs can change only name, tagline and colour. Says which changes were applied and which this design can't do, and offers a builder alternative when it can't. Do not use this for a logo made elsewhere, or for a different business, which is find_designs.

changes.description: Only what the person asked to change.

colour.description: A colour word or a colour name from list_options.

font.description: A font id, or a style such as 'modern', or 'different'.

graphic.description: The graphic asked for, such as 'stacked boxes'.

placement.description: A placement id, or words such as 'name underneath'.

tagline.description: Use an empty string to remove it.

state.description: The design's state exactly as returned by the last Webba tool result. Don't edit it by hand.

name: update_design
title: Change a design
